description: This file defines the Angular component 'ToastContainerComponent', responsible for displaying transient toast notifications. It subscribes to the ToastService to get current toasts and renders them with styling and accessibility considerations.

classes.name: ToastContainerComponent
classes.description: Angular component that displays toast notifications in a fixed position, styled with CSS, accessible via ARIA attributes, and updates based on the ToastService signals.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Method to dismiss a toast notification by its id, delegating to the ToastService.

methods.name: trackById
methods.description: Method used for NgFor trackBy to optimize rendering by identifying toasts via their unique 'id' property.
